heading: Thursday, April 30, 2026
topLine: xAI releases Grok 4.3 to the API.

items.headline: xAI releases Grok 4.3 to the API
items.summary: Grok 4.3, an always-on reasoning model with a 1M-token context, became generally available via the xAI API after an April subscriber beta, priced at $1.25/$2.50 per million input/output tokens. Artificial Analysis scored it 53 on its Intelligence Index; xAI also launched voice cloning and voice agent APIs.
